_comment: Pre-approved SonarCloud hotspot allowlist for ThumbGate.
Each entry marks a specific (filePath, ruleKey, lineSubstring) triple as
REVIEWED / SAFE when SonarCloud detects it. The auto-reviewer script
(scripts/sonar-review-hotspots.js) runs in CI between the Sonar scan
and the Quality Gate check; the gate's new_security_hotspots_reviewed
metric passes once every hotspot is reviewed. Changes to this file
should be reviewed in PR like any other security policy change.

reviews.rationale: Installer MUST resolve git via the developer's own PATH. Git ships from many locations (brew, apt, scoop, Xcode, Git-for-Windows); pinning an absolute path would break every machine. The command literal ('git') is hard-coded, not user input, and args is always an array, so no shell interpolation is possible. Reviewed 2026-04-21.

Trajectory scoring needs a local git diff to compare changed files against the user's primer. The command is a fixed literal, cwd is the project root, and no user-controlled text is interpolated into the shell command. Reviewed 2026-05-31 for the v1.26.0 orchestration release.
Simple trailing slash trimmer regex matches only slashes at the end of the string. Not vulnerable to catastrophic backtracking.
Runs global npm install for self-update. The command is a hardcoded literal and doesn't use user-provided input.
Spawns curl with hardcoded command and array args to perform safe REST API fallback request. Prevents shell injection.
Runs local validation suite. The command is a hardcoded literal without user input.
Runs git add command. The command is a hardcoded literal without user input.
Runs git commit command. The command is a hardcoded literal without user input.
